nodes.description: uint256 public _tokenId, monotonically incremented counter used as the next NFT token id
uint256 public _charId, counter used as key when registering a new PVP character
mapping(uint256 => Pvp) public pvps holding uri, price, units and currentUnits per character
mint(uint256 charId) public payable, takes payment, mints ERC721 to msg.sender and increments pvps[charId].currentUnits
admint(uint256 charId, address recipient) public payable onlyOwner, privileged mint to a chosen recipient
addPVP(string _uri, uint256 _price, uint256 _units) public onlyOwner, registers a new PVP character
withdrawAll() public, transfers the whole contract balance to owner() using a low level send
pause() public onlyOwner, triggers the emergency pause
unpause() public onlyOwner, lifts the emergency pause
initialize() initializer public, wires up ERC721, URI storage, pausable, ownable, burnable and UUPS modules
_beforeTokenTransfer(from,to,tokenId) internal whenNotPaused override hook executed on every mint/burn/transfer
_authorizeUpgrade(address newImplementation) internal onlyOwner, gate for the UUPS upgrade mechanism
_burn(uint256 tokenId) internal override chaining ERC721 and ERC721URIStorage burn logic
tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view override returning the resolved metadata URI
_baseURI() internal pure override returning the pinned ipfs gateway prefix
constructor() initializer, locks the implementation contract so it cannot be initialised directly
msg.sender, attacker controlled caller used for authorization checks and as mint recipient
payable(owner()).send(amount) low level value transfer that forwards gas to the owner address
_safeMint performs an external call to onERC721Received on the receiving contract before state is finalised
target.delegatecall(data) executed by _functionDelegateCall during UUPS upgrades
upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall external entry points that authorize and then delegatecall into the new implementation
charId parameter of mint, externally supplied index into the pvps mapping
pvp memory copy of pvps[charId] loaded inside mint
charId parameter of admint, index into the pvps mapping
recipient address parameter of admint receiving the minted token
pvp memory copy of pvps[charId] loaded inside admint
_uri parameter of addPVP, metadata uri stored for the character
_price parameter of addPVP, required payment per mint
_units parameter of addPVP, maximum supply for the character
newPVP memory struct built in addPVP before being stored in pvps
amount local variable holding address(this).balance inside withdrawAll
newImplementation address parameter of _authorizeUpgrade supplied by the caller

edges.reason: caller supplied charId is passed into mint and used to select the PVP entry
charId is used as the mapping key when reading pvps[charId]
the copied Pvp struct pvp drives the price and uri checks inside mint
msg.sender is used as the recipient of the newly minted token in mint
mint increments _tokenId which is then used as the new token id
mint calls _safeMint which performs an untrusted external callback before pvps state is updated
a malicious recipient contract re-enters mint from onERC721Received while currentUnits is stale
mint writes pvps[charId].currentUnits after the external safeMint call
charId selects which PVP character is minted by the owner in admint
recipient is the address that receives the token minted in admint
the copied Pvp struct pvp supplies the uri and supply bound used by admint
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender() to restrict admint
admint increments _tokenId for the newly minted token
admint calls _safeMint which makes an external onERC721Received callback to the recipient
the recipient contract can re-enter admint through the onERC721Received callback
admint increments pvps[charId].currentUnits after the external call
_uri is stored into the newly created PVP entry by addPVP
_price is stored as the mint price of the new PVP entry
_units is stored as the supply cap of the new PVP entry
the newPVP struct is populated and written to storage by addPVP
addPVP increments _charId to generate the next character key
addPVP stores the new PVP struct at pvps[_charId]
onlyOwner restricts addPVP to the contract owner
withdrawAll reads address(this).balance into the amount local variable
withdrawAll executes a low level send that hands control and gas to the owner address
the send call can invoke a fallback on a contract owner which may re-enter withdrawAll
onlyOwner restricts who may call pause
onlyOwner restricts who may call unpause
newImplementation is the argument validated by _authorizeUpgrade
onlyOwner in _authorizeUpgrade checks _msgSender() before allowing an upgrade
upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall route through _authorizeUpgrade before changing the implementation
the upgrade entry points are externally callable and rely on caller identity for authorization
after authorization the upgrade path performs a delegatecall into the new implementation
_baseURI supplies the prefix concatenated into the tokenURI result
tokenURI queries _baseURI to build the returned metadata location
_mint invoked by mint triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
the safe mint path reaches _beforeTokenTransfer which enforces whenNotPaused
_burn routes through the same _beforeTokenTransfer pause hook

normalization_plan.reason: the charId parameter has no meaning outside mint and should be folded into the mint function node
the pvp memory copy is a temporary holder read from pvps inside mint and belongs to the mint node
the charId parameter is only consumed by admint and should be merged into its function node
the recipient parameter exists solely as the token destination of admint and merges into it
the pvp local struct is an internal cache used only by admint
_uri is stored only by addPVP and has no independent semantic identity
_price is written directly into the new PVP record by addPVP
_units is written directly into the new PVP record by addPVP
newPVP is an ephemeral struct assembled and persisted by addPVP
amount is a short lived balance snapshot used only to feed the unsafe send call in withdrawAll
the newImplementation argument is only meaningful as the guarded input of _authorizeUpgrade
